systems.owner: Ministère de la santé publique et de la prévention, designed and set up with WHO technical support

systems.system: systèmes de surveillance et de suivi des maladies

note: The passages describe a national data analysis centre created by the health ministry under the Plan stratégique national pour la santé numérique 2025-2030 (WHO equipment handed over June 2026), which is to consolidate data from DHIS2 and other systems; DHIS2 and the hospital systems are named without saying what they do, so neither is classed and no fact is recorded.
